static_traits.name: Wendy
static_traits.social_status: Has friends and classmates to talk with, but relationships have grown distant due to stress and negative thinking
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without以往心理咨询/治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述内心想法；Low mood，倾向Self-denial与聚焦负面；配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 在一门课程拿到B后，我一直在与低自我价值感和对not成功的Fear作斗争。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed these negative thoughts are affecting my overall physical and mental health and self-confidence, and in turn my academic performance.

special_situations.event: Receiving a B grade in a course
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能在每一门课都拿到A，就说明I failed/not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets new goals and pushes himself harder to prove he is capable
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我拿了B，就说明I am a failure

special_situations.event: 在思考not yet来职业前景时联想到这次B
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果学业not能完美，我在竞争激烈的行业里就一定会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我鞭策、增加投入以避免not yet来失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined to fail，既然现在一门课都拿not好，将来更not行

special_situations.event: When studying or doing other homework, this B grade repeatedly surfaces
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失误会negate我之前所有的成绩
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与他人讨论、Reduced socializing以避免被评价，并持续盯住错误提醒自己not要松懈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这一个B说明I am not good enough，其他成绩都not算数

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends/classmates, worries about being asked about this grade and feelings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表达脆弱或谈及挫折，do not人会看轻我、认为我软弱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distances himself from friends, avoids talking about feelings to prevent being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很弱、看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized in academics and career, to have one's worth seen
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被negate、被视为软弱，从而失去价值与机会
defense_goal: Avoids failing again and shame by maintaining harsh standards and self-criticism
Keeps a certain distance from others to avoid being judged as weak

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/会看not起我的他人（朋友、同学、not yet来雇主）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others suggest viewing B as a learning opportunity, or point out positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: This is making excuses for failure; it will make me slack off
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气坚决但平静，反复use“但是”negate积极证据，强调“这只是找借口”，减少情感表达。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of expressing his frustration to friends or classmates or seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他们会觉得我软弱并看not起我
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以迟疑、担忧的语气提出他人负面看法的假设，然后迅速闭口或Displacement话题，减少细节披露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被B成绩激发出羞耻和Anxiety时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 只有严厉批评自己才not会再次失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use苛刻的自我评价，如“I am not good enough/I am just a failure”，语气短促、强硬，回避探索更柔和的感受。

manifestations: After getting a B, has the thought 'then what is the point / why bother trying anymore'
Strongly binds self-worth to grades and achievements
对not yet来职业前景产生宿命式的失败Anticipation
outcomes: Decreased sense of self-worth、Anxiety与压力上升
Distant from friends, avoiding expressing vulnerability

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats 'I must get an A in every course' as a rigid self-evaluation standard
反复强调“如果我not逼自己，我就永远not会成功”

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Worried friends will think she is weak, thereby avoiding communicating with them
Assumes others' negative judgment in social settings

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 对自我表达高度谨慎，反复自责与Self-denial
Difficult to accept positive evidence, worried that 'being lenient with myself will make me worse'

positive_force: 曾在其他课程中取得Good成绩（具备真实的学业能力证据）
Has social support resources such as contactable friends and classmates
Can proactively set goals and invest effort (self-motivation)
Willing to seek counseling and try new methods (help-seeking motivation and willingness to change)
negative_force: 非黑即白思维与灾难化Anticipation，过度概括单一失败
Strongly binds self-worth to grades, relying on external evaluation
对被视为软弱的Fear导致Social avoidance，削弱支持
反刍思维加重压力，导致Sleep and diet disturbance

target_behavior.behavior: 围绕B成绩的反复反刍与对not yet来的灾难化思考
antecedent: While studying or doing other homework
思考not yet来职业前景时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与成绩绑定，害怕失败并倾向以灾难化方式预测not yet来
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid failing again through self-vigilance and self-blame (escaping being blamed and losing control)
target_behavior.consequence: Rising stress、LearningDecreased efficiency，Sleep and diet disturbance持续

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding communicating with friends, distancing from social life
antecedent: When cared about by friends / classmates or thinking of talking about grades and feelings
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被视为软弱、被看not起（个人化与读心术）
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible shame and negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、Reduced social support，Negative emotions persisting或加重

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep difficulties与Decreased appetite（压力相关生理反应）
antecedent: 临睡前反复担心学业与not yet来
Still in a high-arousal state after high-pressure daytime study
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety与反刍维持高唤醒，难以下调生理激活
target_behavior.function: 保持警觉以应对感知的威胁（对“失败”的Over-preparation）
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental exhaustion, reduced attention and executive functioning, further affecting studies and mood
